items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: One time, Joe Glaser and I, we had a little argument about the uniforms, you know.

ctx.x: them. They weren't buying them. They should have been paying for them. One time, Joe Glaser and I, we had a little argument about the uniforms, you know. We weren't supposed to wear the uniforms in the street, naturally enough...but it wasn't nothin' but a suit.

So here we are, we're down in one of them Southern towns one Sunday morning and gettin' ready to leave. So I come to the bus all dressed up in my uniform. And Joe Glaser saw me about a block away, and he hollered at me. Joe hollered anyway; he got excited, you know, he would holler anyway. He says, "Charlie, you know you're not supposed to wear that uniform out in the street!" I said, "Well, Mr. Glaser, if you don't want me to wear a uniform in the street, you pay for it."
